title: Replace a commercial agent licence
summary: You can apply for a replacement commercial agent licence if your original licence has been lost, damaged, or destroyed.
intro: If your commercial agent licence has been lost, damaged or destroyed, you can apply for a replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and visit a service centre to submit your application.

more_info.text: If you're replacing the licence due to a printing error, the replacement is free.
To look up your commercial agent licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

internal_links.text: Apply for a commercial agent licence – individual/sole trader
Apply for a commercial agent licence – corporation
Change the details on a commercial agent licence

faqs.q: Who can apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: The licence holder (individuals/sole traders) or an authorised officer (corporations) can apply.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Download PDF form' button, complete the form, and visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You must have your fee payment.
